data.gender_notes: Nadiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nadiah is a name that symbolizes tenderness and delicacy. It reflects the gentle nature of a person and is often associated with kindness and compassion. In Islamic tradition, the name Nadiah is believed to bring peace and tranquility to those who bear it. The name Nadiah carries the meaning “Tender, delicate, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadiah usually hope their child will grow to embody tender, delicate, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nadiah is also mentioned in Hadith as a name associated with virtues and good deeds. It is said that a person with the name Nadiah will be blessed with a kind heart and a compassionate soul.
data.etymology: Nadiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender, delicate, gentle.”
